sampling_convention.pixel_index: Integer x/y index addresses texel; texel spans [x,x+1] by [y,y+1].
sampling_convention.outsole_edge_proxy: Within each explicitly recorded boot ROI, select the greatest y row containing alpha>=96; x is mean of those texel centers, y is bottom row index+1.

sampling_convention.coordinate_audit_correction: Use geometric lower edges consistently with old idle13-16 proxies: x=mean(column+0.5), y=last alpha>=96 row+1. Walk lower-edge y are92,90,87,89,85,90. Never substitute texel row indices for those edge coordinates.

source_roi_summary.root_relation: All source canvases use the same actor draw origin (16,64). Exposed shadow remains right of root by 48..66 px; top is 5..7 px above root. Root is a draw anchor, not a proven contact point.
source_roi_summary.identifiable: right/up exposed cast direction and stable actor-relative envelope
source_roi_summary.not_identifiable: receiver slope, physical ground, support leg, exact crown-shadow correspondence, limb depth, true physical light or motion
source_roi_summary.no_color_mask: No source RGB was removed or used as a global body mask. Exact RGB(16,8,8) is certified only inside the stated exposed ROI; matching RGB elsewhere is not safe evidence for deletion.

initial_trial.body_to_parent: Exactly the body transform; at native scale1, origin=actor_draw_origin-(16,64). No extra body shift, per-frame foot following or source-shadow pass.
initial_trial.rationale: Stable actor-relative 2D heuristic near the idle torso-center ground ordinate (~87.0), compatible with exposed source right/up lobe, and balancing foot-edge mismatch. It is not the exact walk-edge minimax.
initial_trial.status: historical original y87.5 visual compromise; not the unique current decision or numerical optimum

projection_contract.h_meaning: screen-space projection residual, not physical foot height; positive and negative residuals are allowed and reported
projection_contract.receiver_semantics: an actor-relative 2D receiver reference; never describe synthetic line points as two planted soles
projection_contract.singularity_note: For slope0 and current cast, determinant=111/279, safely nonsingular.

acceptance_limits: Source direction is observed; magnitude remains inherited visual estimate from source13.
52 has only one independently visible boot; do not invent a second anchor.
53 has two boots at nearby screen heights; neither two-contact nor one-lift interpretation is proven.
56 boots nearly share x; naive line is steep and unstable, not a ground estimate.
A higher-screen boot may be further in ground depth rather than raised. Horizontal reference conflates depth and height.
A fixed horizontal receiver cannot guarantee exact attachment for every boot in idle and walk; reported mismatches are expected 2D approximation cost, not body registration fixes.

Keep the old standalone two-foot idle pilot frozen. A joint fixed-receiver preview may use one unchanged line for all ten frames, eliminating action-dependent line switches but changing idle far-foot shadow by about 5.216 px at y87.5.
No contact ellipse, source checker, duplicate shadow, body deformation, per-frame y-offset, raw edit or registration edit.
Native single-shadow, alpha-region, depth ordering, terrain and full-loop visual acceptance remains with the sole GUI owner.

walk_screen_lower_visible_boot_edges_onl.excludes: Other visible walk foot and all idle feet; not support-leg selection

joint_idle_both_visible_outsoles_plus_wa.excludes: Other high-screen walk feet; no contact proof

all_visible_feet_joint.scope: Mathematical contrast only; flattening all visible high-screen walk feet is not an intended visual objective or physical model

distinct_minimax_objectives.rule: Do not call different measurement subsets the same minimax problem. Fixed y87.5 is an original visual compromise, not any claimed numerical optimum.
